description: New General ACCDB. 7 tables (S Counter, K TEXT(20), N Long) with no key; on each one DAO index IX is created with TableDef.CreateIndex, one CreateField per column and the properties (Primary, Unique, Required, IgnoreNulls): (K) primary+IgnoreNulls; (K, N) primary; (K, N) unique+IgnoreNulls; (K, N) unique+Required; (K) IgnoreNulls; (K) Required; (K, N) Required+IgnoreNulls. Each Indexes.Append result is an observation. Then six INSERTs per table over the tuples (Null, Null), (a, Null), (a, 1), (Null, 1), (a, 1), (Null, Null), one per statement; reads the surviving S of each table and every index of each table. An image is kept after each table. Asks which property combinations DAO admits on an empty table, what each reads back as, and which inserts each combination refuses.
